name: 数据总账
prompt:
Use case: ui-mockup
Asset type: high-fidelity desktop web app compositional concept, 1440x1000
Primary request: Redesign the Chinese computer-science learning platform ‘词元研究所’ as a restrained science-fiction mainframe mission console. This is composition option C, ‘data ledger’.
Scene/backdrop: full desktop app viewport, no device frame, deep graphite-black operational surface.
Subject: a real learning dashboard. A narrow 240px left navigation column holds the wordmark 词元研究所, user status, and navigation items 总览, 学习中心, RAG辅导, 代码练习, 学习画像. The remaining page is a vertical technical ledger: the upper third is a full-width current mission strip 今日任务 / Python 函数 with a large segmented progress figure 68%, short goal copy, and one primary button 继续学习. The lower area is a dense but orderly 12-column matrix: one tall 学习路径 timeline on the left and a two-column stack on the right containing course mastery rows for C语言, Python, 数据结构, recent evidence sources, and deterministic code-verification status. A theme color switcher is visibly integrated as three small labelled swatches: 离子青, 脉冲红, 太阳金.
Style/medium: exceptionally polished product UI concept, mainframe data ledger fused with scientific instrumentation, modern semantic layout, real controls and readable cards, not a poster.
Composition/framing: left navigation plus broad ledger page, strong horizontal rules, no detached floating cards, variable-height modules aligned to one grid, primary task strip as focal region.
Color palette: near-black and cool slate neutrals with one selectable ion-cyan accent active; cyan appears only in current state, progress, focus, and primary action. Alternative theme swatches are tiny functional controls, not decorative color blocks. No red frames.
Materials/textures: matte operational display, fine one-pixel rules, registration marks, serial labels and numeric readouts; no glassmorphism, no glossy 3D.
Typography: Chinese sans-serif content, compact monospaced numerals and uppercase English metadata. No oversized headline.
Constraints: desktop application screen; unmistakably a computer-science learning product; clear information hierarchy; restrained sci-fi, not cyberpunk; no decorative charts; no gradients; no huge slogan; no floating rounded pill clusters; no purple; no neon glow haze; no robots, spaceships, planets, photographs, or marketing illustration; no watermark.
